To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a temporal algebraic foundation that is general enough to capture the temporal semantics of all existing query languages and that is also general enough to capture duplicate removal and retention, and order preservation for queries, is presented; (ii) a temporal query optimizer based on this foundation is developed, which is capable of optimizing queries involving duplicates and order; and (iii) the temporal query optimizer is shown to be able to optimize queries involving duplicates and temporal queries.
